meta.label: Demo company / Synthetic data
meta.business: Three NC lodging properties operated by one LLC: select-service hotel in Raleigh (owned, 60 rooms), coastal leisure hotel in Wilmington (leased, 52 rooms), aparthotel in Durham (leased, 44 apartments), plus a shared corporate office
meta.fiscal_year_note: Fiscal year runs November–October; FY2026 = Nov 2025–Oct 2026
cash_rules: Opening cash is the operating bank only. Gateway clearing, cash in transit and earned OTA remittances enter once, as inflows on their expected dates.
Known balances at cutoff (open corporate AR, vendor AP, October payroll, lodging tax, agency commission, debt service, security returns, capex PO) come from the source subledgers, each once.

On-the-books stays: prepaid amounts already held as deposits are not collected again; guest balances arrive via the gateway (2 business days + weekly payout), merchant OTA nights as weekly net releases, corporate stays 65%/35% after the month-end invoice.
New bookings fill only capacity left after on-the-books nights (target occupancy × available − OTB), using assumption version FC-2026-10-31-BASE; this is the only estimated revenue.
Future payroll is generated from active employees, effective rates and the payroll calendar; October H2 payroll is a known obligation and not repeated.
Recurring contracts start with November service (October bills are already in open AP). Member distributions and new capital projects beyond the approved PO are excluded.
meta.cash_floor_note: The $2.0M cash floor is a demo assumption, not a covenant: about 4.2 months of average bank outflows ($474,670/month over the last 12 months).

rows.story: Wilmington (WIL) lost 344 room-nights to the Feb–Mar 2026 refurbishment closures; budget kept full capacity, capex $64,000 capitalized in 2026-03.
Raleigh (RAL) had 44 out-of-order room-nights in 2026-07 (HVAC); maintenance stays in opex, not capex.
Summer OTA share of sold nights rose from 24.5% (Jul–Sep 2025) to 34.6% (Jul–Sep 2026); commission per sold night $7.28→$11.36.
Corporate client CO-001 holds $70,071 of $284,250 open corporate AR (9 invoices, up to 16 days past due); 9 of its 12 invoices since Jul 2026 service are still open.
FY2026 revenue −$77k vs original budget (-1.2%): RAL +$71k, WIL +$20k, DUR −$168k. EBITDA −$99k vs budget, of which DUR −$71k.
Wilmington (WIL) paid $9,745 for agency housekeepers in Jun–Aug 2026 while three staff housekeepers were on unpaid absence.
13-week cash: opening $2.76M, base-case low $2.48M (week of Nov 29), $2.65M on 30 Jan 2027.
